summary: The match test compares a string to a regex using Python's re.match, so the pattern is anchored at the start of the string.
questions: How do I check if a string starts with a regex pattern?
Why doesn't my match test find a pattern in the middle of a string?
What's the difference between match and search tests?

answer_card.title: match test (anchored regex)
answer_card.answer_md: `string is match(pattern)` uses Python `re.match`, so the pattern must match from the **start** of the string. Use `search` or `regex` to match anywhere.
